# NeuralNetworkSpectralAnalysis

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The study of eigenvalue spectra of weight matrices in neural networks to infer dynamical properties such as stability, memory capacity, and phase transitions. Provides a mathematical framework to design neuromorphic hardware with desired computational properties, linking network topology to functional outcomes.
